name: Presidency of Kenya
notes: The President is head of state and government; not a chamber, so no seat chart.

name: National Assembly of Kenya
notes: 349 members: 290 constituency seats, 47 county women representatives, 12 nominated. Party counts are from Mzalendo, the civil-society tracker of Parliament (parliament.go.ke's own party breakdown is only a PDF that could not be read). It records each member's party as at the 2022 election and does not model later party switches or by-election changes, so the blocks are approximate. 'Other parties' pools 12 members of parties with one or two seats each. 10 seats are not in Mzalendo's list (mostly nominated members). No member is named here; no supporter sits, so no seat is lit.

name: Senate of Kenya
notes: 67 seats: 47 county senators, 16 women, 2 youth and 2 persons with disabilities nominated by parties. Party counts from Mzalendo (they sum to 67), recorded as at 2022; later switches are not modelled. No supporter sits.
